title: An integer multiplicity triple pairs integrably with every continuous compactly supported covector field in U
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n). Let β : ℝ^P → Λ^n(ℝ^P) be a continuous field of n-covectors with compact support and tsupport β ⊆ U. Then x ↦ θ(x)·ξ(x)(β(x)) is integrable with respect to H^n⌞M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous β → HasCompactSupport β → tsupport β ⊆ U → Integrable (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (β x)) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier)
